brief:
Israeli forces continued uprooting olive trees and closed a agricultural road in the village of Deir Ballut, the Ma'an news agency reported. The actions are part of ongoing operations affecting Palestinian agricultural land in the area.

The closure of the farm road further restricts Palestinian farmers' access to their fields. Olive cultivation remains central to the livelihoods of many Palestinian communities in the West Bank.
title: Israel uproots olive trees, closes farm road in Deir Ballut
